Example Working Group                                         A. Example
Request for Comments: 9999                                      May 2026

The key words "MUST", "MUST NOT", "SHOULD", and "MAY" in this document
are to be interpreted as described in BCP 14 [RFC 2119] [RFC 8174].

1. Protocol Behaviour

A sender MUST emit one HELLO message before application data.
A receiver SHOULD reject an unknown version.
